les: Helder water is nog nie veilige water nie
kaps_punt: voorsiening van skoon water is belangrik vir mense, plante en diere; water kan skoongemaak word deur prosesse soos sif, filtrasie, uitsakking, oorgieting, kook en die byvoeging van chemikalieë om kieme dood te maak; munisipale water word skoongemaak voor en na ons dit gebruik het

items.bewering: Kieme uit toiletafval kan in 'n rivier beland. Mense kan siektes soos diarree kry as hulle daardie water drink.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Diarrhea': infectious diarrhoea is 'often acquired from food or water that has been contaminated by feces'; 'improper fecal disposal leads to contamination'.

items.bewering: Gif soos insekgif kan ook in water oplos. Die gif kan plante en diere siek maak of doodmaak as hulle daarin lewe of daaruit drink.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Pesticide': over 98% of sprayed insecticides reach non-target places including water; pesticides are a cause of water pollution and reduce invertebrate biodiversity in streams. 'kan' keeps the claim within what sources support (not every insecticide is highly soluble).

items.bewering: Kieme is te klein om met die blote oog te sien. Daarom kan helder water nog kieme en opgeloste stowwe dra.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Bacteria': typically 0.5-5.0 micrometres, not visible to the unaided eye (the rare giant species are not disease germs). Dissolved substances by definition leave water clear.

items.bewering: Party maniere maak die water helderder deur dinge uit te haal wat jy kan sien. Ander maniere maak kieme in die water dood.
items.bron: CDC, 'Making water safe in an emergency' (cdc.gov/healthywater/emergency/making-water-safe.html): settle or filter cloudy water first, then boil or disinfect; Wikipedia 'Water purification': physical removal steps followed by disinfection.

items.bewering: 'n Sif hou groot stukke soos blare en plastiek uit modderige water terug.
items.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Water purification': the first step is screening to 'remove large debris such as sticks, leaves, rubbish'.

items.bewering: By uitsakking staan die water stil in 'n emmer sodat modder en sand na die bodem sak. By oorgieting gooi jy die helderder water versigtig bo-af uit sodat die modder agterbly.
items.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
items.bron: CDC emergency water guidance: 'allow it to settle' then draw off the clear water above the sediment (settling and decanting). Terms uitsakking and oorgieting are the ones the CAPS bullet itself uses.

items.bewering: By filtrasie loop die water deur papier, lap of sand. Stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies bly agter.
items.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
items.bron: CDC: filter cloudy water through cloth, paper towel or coffee filter; Wikipedia 'Filter paper': particles are caught on the surface or in the bulk of the paper. The sentence does not claim that only oversized pieces are held, so it does not conflict with depth filtration in sand.

items.bewering: Gekleurde water kom net so gekleur uit as jy dit deur filtreerpapier gooi. Die kleurstof het opgelos en sy deeltjies is te klein om vasgevang te word. Hulle versprei tussen die water se deeltjies.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Filter paper': qualitative paper pores 2-25 micrometres and it traps particles, not dissolved material; a dissolved dye is dispersed as molecules far smaller than that. Holds for the water-soluble food colouring a classroom would use.

items.bewering: Baie kieme is ook so klein dat hulle deur 'n filter kan kom wat jy self maak. Hierdie vier maniere maak water helderder maar kan nie seker maak dat die kieme weg is nie.
items.bron: Bacteria 0.5-5 micrometres (Wikipedia 'Bacteria') against filter paper pores of 2-25 micrometres (Wikipedia 'Filter paper'); even a well-run slow sand filter gives 90-99% bacterial reduction, not complete removal (Wikipedia 'Slow sand filter'). CDC treats filtering/settling only as preparation before boiling or disinfecting.

items.bewering: As jy water kook tot dit hard borrel, gaan die kieme dood wat siektes soos diarree veroorsaak.
items.bron: WHO, quoted in Wikipedia 'Portable water purification': 'bringing water to rolling boil then naturally cooling is sufficient to inactivate pathogenic bacteria, viruses and protozoa'. CDC advises a rolling boil for 1 minute; the lesson's 'tot dit hard borrel' matches the WHO wording.

items.bewering: Kook haal nie modder of opgeloste stowwe uit nie.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Water purification': boiling 'cannot remove chemical toxins or impurities' and does not remove dissolved contaminants; CDC says to settle or filter cloudy water before boiling.

items.bewering: Laat die gekookte water afkoel en hou dit toegemaak in 'n skoon houer. So kom nuwe kieme nie maklik weer in nie.
items.bron: CDC: store boiled water in 'clean, sanitized containers with tight covers'; WHO wording 'then naturally cooling'.

items.bewering: 'n Chemikalie kan ook kieme in water doodmaak en die waterwerke gebruik gewoonlik chloor.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Water purification': 'The most common disinfection method involves some form of chlorine or its compounds'. No South African utility page could be loaded (Rand Water site certificate error), so this rests on the general source; chlorination is standard practice and 'gewoonlik' is appropriately hedged.

items.bewering: By die huis kan 'n grootmens watersuiweringstablette in water gooi soos die pakkie sê.
items.bron: CDC: 'Follow the instructions on the label or package of chlorine dioxide, chlorine, or iodine tablets or drops'.

items.bewering: Die chloor en die tablette haal nie modder uit nie. Hulle werk ook beter in helder water omdat modder kieme kan wegsteek. Daarom word water eers helder gemaak voordat die kieme doodgemaak word.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Turbidity': 'suspended solids interfere with water disinfection with chlorine because the particles act as shields for viruses and bacteria'; CDC: settle or filter cloudy water before treating; Wikipedia 'Water purification': disinfection comes after filtration.

items.bewering: Die waterwerke neem water uit 'n rivier of dam. Dit maak die water skoon in stappe wat jy nou ken. 'n Sif vang eers die groot goed en dan staan die water sodat vuilgoed na die bodem uitsak. Daarna loop dit deur lae sand. Laastens maak 'n chemikalie kieme in die water dood.
items.blok: Die waterwerke: voordat ons die water gebruik
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Water purification': after screening comes 'chemical treatment to aggregate particles, then settling in basins', then filtration, then disinfection. Wikipedia 'Flocculation' and 'Turbidity': fine colloidal particles 'will settle only very slowly or not at all' and stay suspended unless a coagulant makes them clump. Sources, rivers and dams, confirmed by Wikipedia 'Water supply and sanitation in South Africa'.
items.regstelling: The order sieve, settling, sand, then a germ-killing chemical is right, but 'Dit maak die water skoon in stappe wat jy nou ken' is not: a waterworks also adds a chemical before the settling tanks that makes the fine dirt clump together so it can sink. That step is not one the learner knows, and without it the fine dirt in river water would not settle. The block also reads as if a chemical is only added at the end. Either say the waterworks uses mostly steps the learner knows, or add in one plain sentence that the works first adds a chemical that makes the fine dirt clump so it sinks. Do not say that the only chemical is the one at the end.

items.bewering: Dan loop die water deur pype na die krane.
items.blok: Die waterwerke: voordat ons die water gebruik
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Water purification': disinfection is applied 'before distribution' through the supply network. Storage reservoirs sit between the works and the tap, but that is not contradicted by the sentence.

items.bewering: Gebruikte water loop uit toilette, wasbakke en storte weg. Dit vloei deur rioolpype na 'n rioolwerke waar dit skoongemaak word voordat dit na 'n rivier of die see loop. So help die rioolwerke keer dat kieme en vuilgoed riviere en die see besoedel.
items.blok: Die rioolwerke: nadat ons die water gebruik het
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Sewage treatment': sewage is 'collected and transported by a network of pipes ... to a municipal treatment plant' and treated to produce effluent 'discharged to the environment while causing as little water pollution as possible'. Note for a human, not a defect: Wikipedia 'Water supply and sanitation in South Africa' reports many SA works failing effluent standards and untreated sewage reaching rivers. The lesson describes what the works is for and says 'help keer', so it does not claim every works succeeds.

items.bewering: Hierdie water is nie drinkwater nie.
items.blok: Die rioolwerke: nadat ons die water gebruik het
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Sewage treatment': treated effluent is reused for irrigation or recharge, not as drinking water. The special reclamation plants such as Beaufort West's (Wikipedia, 'Water supply and sanitation in South Africa') apply further treatment and are not what a sewage works releases.

items.bewering: Jy kan self 'n sandfilter bou met 'n laag growwe klippies en 'n laag fyn sand. Die growwe klippies vang groter stukke en die fyn sand kleiner stukke.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Slow sand filter': layered construction of pebbles and coarse gravel beneath fine sand, with particles trapped as water passes through the sand.

items.bewering: Jy oordeel watter filter beter werk aan hoe helder die water uitkom. Die vergelyking is net regverdig as elke filter dieselfde vuil water en ewe veel daarvan kry.
items.bron: Fair-test principle of controlling variables. Clarity is the right measure because the lesson has already said clarity is not safety. Consistent with Wikipedia 'Turbidity': turbidity measures cloudiness.

items.bewering: Maar helderder beteken nie veilig nie. Jy drink nie water uit jou eie filter nie omdat dit nog kieme en opgeloste stowwe kan dra. Kook of die waterwerke se chemikalie maak wel die kieme dood.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Slow sand filter' (90-99% bacterial reduction, not complete); CDC treats filtering only as a step before boiling or disinfecting; WHO rolling-boil statement via Wikipedia 'Portable water purification'; Wikipedia 'Water purification' on chlorine.

items.bewering: sif: Iets met gaatjies wat kleiner stukke deurlaat en groter stukke terughou.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Water purification' (screening removes large debris); standard meaning of a sieve.

items.bewering: uitsakking: Wanneer vaste stukkies in 'n vloeistof na die bodem sak en daar bly lê.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Turbidity' and 'Water purification' (settling in basins); matches the process CAPS names uitsakking.

items.bewering: oorgiet: Om die vloeistof bo-op versigtig af te gooi sodat wat onder lê, in die houer agterbly.
items.bron: CDC: let cloudy water settle, then draw off the clear water above the sediment (decanting).

items.bewering: filtreer: Om 'n mengsel deur 'n filter te laat loop. Die vloeistof gaan deur, en vaste stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies bly agter.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Filter paper' (particles caught on the surface or in the paper; the liquid passes).

items.bewering: kieme: Baie klein lewende dinge wat 'n mens siek kan maak.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Diarrhea' (viruses, bacteria and parasites as causes) and 'Bacteria' (microscopic living cells). Viruses are not universally counted as living. The house ruling that germs are taught as living at CAPS level (recorded before this check) covers this, and the entry says 'kan', not 'maak altyd'.

items.bewering: opgeloste stof: Die stof wat in 'n vloeistof opgelos het, soos die sout in soutwater.
items.bron: Standard definition of a solute; salt dissolved in water is the canonical example (Wikipedia, 'Solution (chemistry)' convention, consistent with Wikipedia 'Filter paper' on dissolved material passing a filter).

items.bewering: chloor: 'n Chemikalie wat die waterwerke gewoonlik by water gooi om kieme dood te maak.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Water purification': chlorine is the most common disinfectant and 'rapidly kills many harmful micro-organisms'.

items.bewering: watersuiweringstablet: 'n Klein tablet met 'n chemikalie wat kieme in water doodmaak.
items.bron: CDC (chlorine, chlorine dioxide or iodine tablets); Wikipedia 'Portable water purification' (iodine and chlorine dioxide tablets). Some tablets work poorly against Cryptosporidium, but the entry does not claim they kill every germ.

items.bewering: waterwerke: 'n Plek waar water uit 'n rivier of dam vir die krane skoongemaak word.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Water supply and sanitation in South Africa' (rivers and dams as primary sources); Wikipedia 'Water purification' (treatment before distribution).

items.bewering: rioolwerke: 'n Plek waar gebruikte water skoongemaak word voordat dit na 'n rivier of die see gaan.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Sewage treatment' (treated effluent discharged to the environment).

opsomming: One fault to fix: the waterworks block says the works cleans water only in steps the learner already knows, but real works first add a chemical that makes fine dirt clump so it can sink, and fine river dirt does not settle without it. Everything else checks out; the lesson has no superlatives and no analogy block, and the web-search allowance ran out before this check began, so every claim was checked by opening the source pages directly (CDC, WHO as quoted, and Wikipedia) and no South African utility page could be loaded.
